verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a broad public REST API covering Payments, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Chargebacks, Balances, and Webhooks. It also documents scoped authentication (API keys, advanced and OAuth tokens), idempotency keys, an isolated test mode, and a hosted MCP server described as a proxy for the public API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404).
